notes: Breadboard rows follow the catalogue: bank 'b' = rows f-j (upper half in the picture), bank 't' = rows a-e (lower half in the picture). Column/hole numbers are estimated from the picture.

Each pushbutton straddles the centre gap: side 1 (1.l/1.r) sits in the upper half (f row) and side 2 (2.l/2.r) in the lower half (e row). 5V reaches side 1 via a rail wire; the Arduino input wire, the 10k pulldown resistor sit on side 2 (same strip).
Pin mapping from the circuit/schematic: D6 = left-click button, D5 = right, D4 = left, D3 = down, D2 = up.
Top + rail is 'tp' (5V), bottom - rail is 'bn' (GND). Rail hole indexes are approximate; the resistors' lower leads go to the bottom ground rail.
The micro-USB cable to the computer is mentioned in the text but not drawn, so it is not included. 10k resistor is value=10000 (ohms).
